name: Kagoshima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with a circled cross above a red mountain silhouette.
history: The flag of Kagoshima bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Kagoshima municipal emblem — a circled cross above a red mountain silhouette
features.symbolism: the maru-ni-jūmonji cross of the Shimazu lords above erupting Sakurajima
